## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue (if applicable).

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization (VRAM, execution speed)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧹 Code cleanup / refactoring

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines.
- [ ] I have verified that Python files compile without syntax errors (`python -m py_compile ...`).
- [ ] I have tested changes on the target hardware (or CPU emulation).
- [ ] I have updated documentation where necessary.
- [ ] My commits adhere to [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] This change does not violate ethical voice cloning policies or third-party model licenses.
